entities.summary: Mikhaylovka is a town in Volgograd Oblast, Russia, located on the right bank of the Medveditsa River, 210 kilometers (130 mi) northwest of Volgograd. Population: 59,132 (2010 census); 60,034 (2002 census); 58,323 (1989 Soviet census).
